source_title: APi official website; original apigroupcorp.com redirects here
text: Analyst paraphrase of official business page: APi Group provides business services in safety and specialty services. Its safety offering includes life safety systems and risk-response programs. Its specialty services include infrastructure and utility services, specialty contracting, transmission, fabrication, civil work and HVAC mechanical services.

source_title: Company Information; business description only, no public financial disclosures
text: Analyst paraphrase of official company-information page: Avista produces, transmits and distributes energy. Avista Utilities provides electricity and natural-gas services in eastern Washington, northern Idaho and parts of southern and eastern Oregon. A subsidiary also provides retail electric service in Juneau, Alaska. Its generating facilities and long-term energy contracts support a mix of energy sources.
